turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me what’s been going on? Patient: I’ve been feeling increasingly confused lately, and I can’t seem to get my thoughts out clearly. I also had a fever around 102°F and feel discomfort when my right upper abdomen is touched.

turns.doctor_question: Do you often find yourself needing to rush to the bathroom to urinate, or feeling like you can't hold your urine for very long?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t recall needing to rush to urinate or having trouble holding my urine. I’m mostly just more confused than usual, and I feel the discomfort when my right upper abdomen is touched.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any firm lumps or masses in your breast that feel distinct from the rest of the tissue?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any firm lumps or distinct breast masses that feel different from the rest of the tissue. Mostly I’ve been more confused than usual, with a fever around 102°F and discomfort when my right upper abdomen is touched.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, smooth bumps on your skin that feel firm to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any small, smooth bumps on my skin that feel firm to the touch. I’ve mostly been more confused lately, had a fever around 102°F, and I get discomfort when my right upper abdomen is pressed.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you've been having trouble cooling down or regulating your body temperature lately, even when you're not in a hot environment or engaging in physical activity?
turns.patient_answer: I’ve been having trouble keeping my temperature down—I've had a fever around 102°F and I don’t feel like I’m regulating it well. I’m mostly still very confused, and it hurts in my right upper abdomen when you press there.

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or feeling overwhelmed?
turns.patient_answer: I’ve been feeling more confused than usual, and I can’t really tell you about stress—I mostly just feel unwell. I’ve had a fever around 102°F and it hurts when my right upper abdomen is pressed.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching sensations on your skin lately, either all over or in specific areas?

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you're having trouble finding the right words when you want to say something, like a name or a word that's on the tip of your tongue?

When my right upper abdomen is pressed, it feels very uncomfortable, but I can’t say much about muscle stiffness.
